ops.title: Search guard gaps: value-terminated clusters, long-option abbreviations, egrep/fgrep/ug, heredoc stdin
ops.description: Known gaps recorded in PR #401: -rnA3 and --recurs read as non-recursive (fail open); heredoc-fed rg, ugrep --and -e PATTERN, and grep -r -d skip fall closed. Fixing clusters needs a core CommandSchema change, which the overlay activation forbade.

ops.text: grep -rnA3 needle . at a repository root is denied (CommandSchema binds a cluster whose last letter takes a value)
egrep/fgrep/ug recursive whole-root searches are covered or explicitly ruled out
rg needle <<EOF at a repository root is allowed (heredoc stdin visible to the guard)
